dividend_store_fix.process_lesson: The Aug-08 run wrote 'already seeded in dividend_tracker.py; the ex-date alert will fire'. That was checked against the SOURCE CODE, not the STORE, and the store is what the function reads. Confirming the right data exists in a seed function is not confirming it is retrievable.
